## Optional: Create the codebook in DataWiz2

You can also use [DataWiz2](https://datawiz2.beta.zpid.org) for this (see the instructions in the video "- [PTOS 9: Introduction to Research Data Management with D-Psy_FAIR](https://zpid.cloud.panopto.eu/Panopto/Pages/Viewer.aspx?id=a8a6b29f-959e-44b2-b829-af5500be5bc7)", starting at minute 29:27).
In DataWiz2, you only need the sections "2. Upload and describe datasets" and then "5. Export".
You then upload our data set.
When exporting, please select "Export as JSON" and in "Include datasets" select all datasets.
